== Set inventory and possibly faulty data ==

The table distinguishes booster expansions, supplemental products, editions and starter packaging. A starter quantity counts cards packed in a deck. Premium and foil counts identify the relevant subset rather than the random older cards bundled with it.

=== Release dates ===
* Decipher's ''The Expansions'' product history dates [[Premiere Unlimited]] and its starters to February 1996. The collecting catalog and the [[Special:PermanentLink/243547|prior Main Page]] give April 1996. The published table follows the original publisher's date and records the competing value here.
* The same Decipher history labels [[Rebel Leader Packs]] as first distributed in summer 1996 and dates [[Jedi Pack]] to October 1996. The collecting catalog and [[Special:PermanentLink/236539|prior Sets index]] give April 1996 for both.
* Decipher's history and the catalog's timeline date [[Revised Hoth]] to October 1998. The catalog's individual Hoth Revised page says September 1998.
* [[Revised Dagobah]] is dated December 1999 in the collecting catalog. The [[Special:PermanentLink/236539|prior Sets index]] says 1998. Decipher's early-1999 projection was a planned date. The [[Special:PermanentLink/243547|prior Main Page]]'s 1 December day has not been established by the inspected sources.
* Later expansion dates are given to the month supported by the inspected catalog. The exact days shown on the [[Special:PermanentLink/243547|prior Main Page]] and [[Special:PermanentLink/236539|prior Sets index]] need their original release notices checked before adding that precision here.
* The Japanese two-player games have year-only dates in the collecting catalog. Their positions after the dated Japanese releases in the same year do not establish an intra-year release sequence.

=== Counts and destinations ===
* [[Endor (expansion)|Endor]] has 180 standard cards and 18 foils. The 198 figure combines those two printings.
* [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] has 90 standard cards and 9 alternate images. Its 107-card catalog total also includes eight rules and checklist cards. [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]] has 180 standard cards and 9 alternate images, plus seven rules and checklist cards. [[Theed Palace]] has 120 standard cards and 9 alternate images, plus two rules and checklist cards.
* [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] has 54 premiums and 100 pack foils, with five additional playable foil toppers. The [[Special:PermanentLink/236539|prior Sets index]]'s 132 figure does not match those categories. [[Reflections III]] has 100 premiums and 100 foils, whereas that index revision says 113.
* The two English introductory games contain two 60-card decks and a random 15-card Premiere booster. The total 135 is a box quantity, not a unique set size. The six Premiere premiums and eight ESB premiums are subset counts. The original deck lists should remain the basis for distinct deck-title totals.
* The cancelled expansion is [[Skywalkers (expansion)]]. The bare title [[Skywalkers]] is a Premiere Interrupt. The [[Special:PermanentLink/243547|prior Main Page]] and [[Special:PermanentLink/236539|prior Sets index]] linked to the card. The published links use the expansion destination.
* [[Reflections Gold]] remained unreleased. Warren Holland's January 2002 announcement refers to 200 approved cards. The surviving catalog has 310 entries. These are different source statements and do not establish a 310-card planned retail print run. The table leaves its planned release date blank because the original release announcement has not been located. [[Reflections Gold Remastered]] is the independent edition.

The original Decipher product history, planned-expansion preview, card checklist and Gold statement were opened through the established VPS route, and their full bytes were retained. The collecting catalog is a secondary source. Its relevant pages were inspected locally, and the actual 8 October 2026 replay matched the complete retained PDF byte for byte.

== Rules publication overview ==

Added the Premiere booklet, expansion supplements, June 1997 FAQ revision, November 1998 Rulebook/Glossary replacement, the October 1999 online compilation and later supplement chronology. The FAQ existed before the June 1997 partial revision. Publication/update dates are separate from PDF metadata. The broader rules-in-force and card-level interpretation work remains in the existing rules-overhaul stories; this overview links [[Rulebooks]] rather than creating a competing library.

=== Possibly faulty data: January 2002 supplement effective date ===

The original Glossary Supplement is updated 29 January 2002 and says delta-marked gameplay changes become official on 5 February 2002. Decipher's rules index instead says "Gameplay changes effective 02-04-02". Both originals were opened. The era overview uses only the verified document-update date; it does not choose between the effective dates.<ref>[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossarysupplement.pdf Glossary Supplement], Decipher (29 January 2002), p. 1. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041106202626/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossarysupplement.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref>[http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/ Rules], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020616214849/http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/ Internet Archive].</ref>
